method.order: AB/BA for both games; OpenGL then Metal per repeat
method.npcRNG: Both Lua and LOVE RNGs seeded per phase. FireRed benchmark additionally sorts returned neighbor placements before NPC construction and clears its own NPC pool before map entry; no measured NPC update/draw methods are replaced. Emerald uses the unchanged seeded driver path. Exact home/ghost NPC signatures checked before/after across all final variants/backends/repeats; per-trial driver hashes distinguish the equivalent Emerald path.
method.simulation: One deterministic 1/60 second game/audio update per rendered frame, not a wall-time 60 Hz gameplay run; native terrain keeps wall time.
method.metrics: Wall times to queue/transfer/wait, not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS. Process CPU includes engine workers. update and gcStep are outside render; paletteSync is inside body.
method.summary: Each trial equally averages its two maps at a given pixel size; summary is median of trial averages. Tail summaries average map P99s, not pooled P99s. Every complete trial retained.
method.allocationProbe: AFTER ALL timed phases and OS proofs: fresh Gen3Tiles decoder over actual resident ROM-imported banks; one initial sample then 120 palette tick samples with automatic GC stopped; Lua heap increase / 120. Probe has no frames or audio updates and cannot alter earlier JIT/collector state.

limits: One nondedicated host; external load not controlled and protected player not inspected/stopped.
Native OpenGL readback/Cocoa transfer and Metal drawable/present waits remain; reduced palette/GC work does not eliminate all end-to-end variance.

preliminaryMatrix.status: Superseded by final acceptance after moving animated-bank rejection ahead of all RGB scans; not mixed into final summaries. Final source-hash guard correctly rejected promoting the preliminary matrix after the working source changed.

diagnostics.method: LuaJIT 1 ms sampling plus stage wrappers; diagnostic instrumentation only, excluded from final performance comparisons. VM G means collection; not GPU timestamps.

seedOnlyFireRedTrials.status: All eight seed-only FireRed trials retained. One OpenGL pair had unequal NPC states: unordered neighbor construction assigns RNG draws differently. Superseded by fixed-construction acceptance, not filtered by timing.

method.order: FireRed AB/BA/AB, then Emerald AB/BA; OpenGL then Metal per repeat
method.simulation: One deterministic 1/60 second game/audio update per rendered frame, not a wall-time 60 Hz gameplay run; native terrain keeps wall time.
method.metrics: Wall times to queue/transfer/wait, not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS. Process CPU includes engine workers. update and gcStep are outside render; paletteSync is inside body.
method.summary: Each trial equally averages its two maps at a given pixel size; summary is median of trial averages. Tail summaries average map P99s, not pooled P99s. Every complete trial retained.
method.allocationProbe: Outside timing: fresh Gen3Tiles decoder over actual resident ROM-imported banks; one initial sample then 120 palette tick samples with automatic GC stopped; Lua heap increase / 120. Restart and full collection before timing. Probe has no frames or audio updates.

preControlMatrix.status: Same final production code; retained separately because random NPC workloads were not fixed and the allocation probe preceded timing. OpenGL process CPU worsened despite smaller draw tails; no gain inferred from that matrix. Controlled acceptance fixes both measurement confounders.

emeraldSameProcessControl.method: One running Metal process, actual 1280x960; switch only Gen3Tiles.setPaletteTicks implementation in candidate/baseline/baseline/candidate order, two retail maps, 120 warmup/300 measured frames. Baseline method loaded from own archived f3fe09f Gen3Tiles; shared original palette sample implementation. No timed captures/observers or separate OS proofs in this diagnostic. Not pooled into final comparison.
emeraldSameProcessControl.observation: CPU changes with sequence even within one process. The final candidate block is lower than both baseline blocks; this control does not show a consistent additional CPU penalty from the new static check. It does not establish general performance parity or exclude cold-start/system variance.

remainingPerformanceQuestions: FireRed draw-tail and sampler-allocation reductions are reproduced; total OpenGL process CPU is still 4-6% higher in final short trials while Metal CPU is 1-9% lower. No general FPS gain claimed.

Emerald GPU correctness passes and warmed atlas misses remain zero; final Metal 1920 process CPU median is 2.023 -> 2.511 ms (+24.1%). End-to-end performance regression cannot be excluded from these short non-dedicated-host runs. Same-process method switching does not reproduce a consistent static-check penalty.
Battle Dome entry scripts can leave a visible TextBox over the world. Palette graphics are still drawn and tested; these timings do not establish full Battle Frontier gameplay.
